title: Dimmadome Hat
description: A non-serious mod that adds a really, really tall hat.
body:
This non-serious mod adds a really tall hat called the dimmadome hat.

This hat features (perceptably) infinite height.

Terrain collision.

And attack damage by moving the "beam" of the hat into entities.
- The faster you move the more damage you do, however moving too fast may not do anything...

-Compatable via connector

=-=-=[Recipe]

![The Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c21ba572dbbbd0037e684840557aa07e1eb39b52.png)

=-=-=

The attack damage can disabled by creating a file named "no_hat_damage.txt" in the directory where options.txt or server.properties appears.

[This mod can be freely used in modpacks]
